Package index

Posterior Predictive Meta-analytic Networks

Functions for constructing, updating, predicting from, and evaluating Posterior Predictive Meta-analytic Networks.

build_ppmn()
Build the foundational Posterior Predictive Meta-analytic Network (PPMN)
update_ppmn()
Update PPMN function
predict_ppmn()
Predict function for a PPMN object
marginal_ppmn()
Plots the marginal expectations of each edge function with credibility intervals
pred_fit_ppmn()
Predictive fit function to assess performance
disp_ppmn()
Displacement test for PPMN
root_est_ppmn()
Root estimation function

Example data

Example datasets for constructing, updating, and evaluating PPMNs.

example4
Example meta-analytic data for a single PPMN edge
example5
Example meta-analytic data for a multi-edge PPMN
example6
Example meta-analytic data for a larger PPMN
train_data
Example training data for updating a PPMN
val_data
Example validation data for a PPMN
